title: Verify raster requirements
summary: Read one bounded raster and compare its format, dimensions, and alpha-channel presence with explicit technical expectations without judging visual quality.

operations.title: Verify raster
operations.description: Return ordered objective checks for explicit format, width, height, and alpha-channel expectations. A mismatch is a successful fail result, not a provider error.

errors.description: The path or expectation shape is outside the portable contract.
The named raster does not exist.
The path escapes or violates the explicit workspace grant.
The source is not a supported safe raster.
An input size, dimension, pixel, or execution bound was exceeded.
The provider could not safely complete verification.
